correctness.rationale: Source RESULT.md steps 1–5 explicitly construct all 3m+1 vertices in affine chart; give positive contact weights w and covariance with eigenvalues g=3w-8mw², B=3w, w; verify all orbit quadratic norms Q_axis=Q_pair=2m, Q_origin=2m for m<=4 and 8 for m>=4. For any competing ellipsoid, averaging contact inequalities gives trace(S^-1 C)<=1 and determinant AM-GM yields det S>=d^d det C with equality only at center c, S=dC; this is global uniqueness, not symmetry-only. Intrinsic metric multiplies constant modes by m+1 and has chart-volume Jacobian m+1. Independent exact symbolic checks of both branches and finite rational construction (source verification/check_pq_star.py) support algebra.
residual_risks: Finite m=1..9 tests do not establish all-m; all-m identities and determinant argument were read. Metric-specific geometry not affine-invariant.
